verdict.scope_summary: The largest in-scope effect is the addition of two traffic-control regions that split admission into interactive and batch lanes and add constrained-capacity parking/resume behavior. Combined quota and spend enforcement is also moved into an explicit shared upstream admission label. The only surrounding changes are four downstream section-number updates, classified as necessary accommodations for inserting numbered sections 5 and 6. There is no collateral rework. However, the preemption semantic is only partial because the connection structure does not explicitly show batch work being displaced by interactive work; the interactive lane itself feeds the constrained-capacity decision and then the parked-batch path.
